question: In which of the following years did the badminton player PV Sindhu win the Olympics Medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016 and 2020**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• PV Sindhu **won Olympic medals in 2016 and 2020**.
 
• She won a **silver medal **in 2016 and a bronze medal in 2020. 
 
• PV Sindhu is a professional **badminton player from Hyderabad, Telangana.**
 
• She **has also won medals in the World Championships **and Asian Games

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pusarla Venkata Sindhu​ is the first Indian woman to win an Olympic silver medal.
 
• She broke into the top 20 of the BWF World Ranking in September 2012, at the age of 17.
 
• She won a Bronze medal at Tokyo Olympics, in 2020.
 
• She fetched the Silver medal at Rio Olympics, in 2016, South Asian Games, in 2016, and Commonwealth Games held at Gold Coast Australia, in 2018.
 
• She won the Badminton World Federation (BWF) Championships and clinched a Gold.
 
• She has been honored with Arjuna Award (2013), Padma Shri (2015), Major Dhyanchand Khel Ratna (2016), and Padma Bhushan (2020).
